description: This file defines an EvidenceService class responsible for creating, managing, and retrieving evidence packages in a data integrity system. It handles generating evidence package artifacts, creating cryptographic hashes for tamper-evidence, and storing manifests. It also includes an EvidenceError exception class for error handling related to evidence operations.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Exception class for handling evidence-related errors with additional context.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Main service class providing methods to create and retrieve evidence packages with integrity verification.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_evidence_package( self, data_asset_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive evidence package for a specified data asset, including validation reports and approval records, with cryptographic hashes for integrity, and stores it with audit logging.

methods.name: None _store_manifest(self, storage_ref: str, content: str)
methods.description: Stores the evidence manifest JSON content into the file system at a specified storage reference path.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_evidence_package(self, evidence_package_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an evidence package by ID, verifying its integrity based on stored hashes and returning the package details with artifacts.
